recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多個大型、染色質呈細顆粒至點狀的紅血球前驅細胞（原紅血球與嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞）與部分核型不規則的成熟細胞，提示紅血球系增生；但環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）需鐵染色才能確認，本圖 Wright 染色無法直接看到。
features: Increased erythroid precursors including large pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts
Erythroid nuclei with finely stippled, somewhat open (megaloblastoid) chromatin
Deeply basophilic to gray-blue cytoplasm; occasional vacuoles and irregular nuclear outlines
Scattered maturing granulocytes, including a band neutrophil
Background with smeared/crushed cells; ring sideroblasts not assessable without iron stain
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased erythroid precursors, including large pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts with finely stippled, somewhat megaloblastoid chromatin, admixed with maturing granulocytic elements. Mild nuclear irregularity is seen, but definitive dysplasia is limited in this field and many cells are smeared. Blasts are not increased. Ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated on a Romanowsky stain; correlation with a Prussian blue iron stain (≥15% ring sideroblasts, or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation) is required to support MDS with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: B12/folate deficiency gives nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and lacks ring sideroblasts; serum levels distinguish.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥80% erythroid cells with ≥30% pronormoblasts, far exceeding the mixed erythroid and granulocytic population here.
Morphology overlaps; ALAS2 mutation, copper/zinc levels, and clinical history are needed to separate from clonal MDS-RS.
